calendar.raw_padding: 300 leading null minute values and padded UTC dates lie outside the selected Toronto year

charger_inputs.access_basis: Inherited Quebec home/work access proxies and TTS-derived timing, not a new Ontario destination-specific calibration.
charger_inputs.basis: Legacy rounding of 2025 Canada-wide high-home-access Dunsky port-count shares, used as per-parking charger-choice weights. L1 1.6 kW is inherited; DCFC 125 kW is effective average rather than nameplate power.

charging_behavior.corrected_model_behavior: Positive grid charging power is multiplied by 0.9 before battery SOC integration; battery-side mobility draw is unchanged. Corrected Sunday frequency lookup and Saturday day assignment; fixed UTC weather lookup.
charging_behavior.emergency_rules: Rounded SOC at or below 25% or insufficient energy for the next trip bypasses ordinary probability/time gates; outside-window charging can occur.

driver_inputs.basis: Inherited Ontario Census occupation/student population proportions used as driver proxies, not survey-weighted counts of observed EV drivers.
driver_inputs.classes: Working, student and inactive cohorts crossed with small/medium/large vehicles; occupation/vehicle shares select CA entries in the supplied tables.

key_assumptions.scope: Ontario-shaped BEV fleet charging demand used as a proxy for shared LDV charging; not measured charger utilization, destination-resolved plug availability, a new market forecast or a direct input-energy requirement after CANOE utilization scaling.

vehicle_inputs.basis: Inherited weighted 2023 beginning-of-life capacities with 2022 US sales/range composition from the legacy workbook; equivalence to current backend OMEGA derivation is not established.
vehicle_inputs.vehicle_class_shares: Prepared CA row in vehicle_share.csv; fleet/BEV range composition is embedded in the simulated output and must not be applied again.

weather_inputs.basis: Inherited population-weighted Renewables Ninja/MERRA-2 CA temperature series; source timestamps are treated as UTC. The local simulation clock is America/Toronto.
weather_inputs.processing: Actual hourly UTC timestamps held constant over each hour; local simulation times converted to UTC for weather lookup. Spring nonexistent times shift forward; repeated fall times use standard time. No source-cache edits.

manifest_self_hash: Not embedded; avoid a recursive checksum. All other catalogue files are listed.

day.label: Day Charge
day.ordinary_window: 07:00 inclusive to 18:00 exclusive, Toronto local clock
day.schedule: Use the same smart scheduler as Night Charge with the daytime window.

night.label: Night Charge
night.ordinary_window: 22:00 inclusive to 07:00 exclusive, Toronto local clock
night.schedule: Spread requested energy across eligible parked minutes, capped by sampled charger power.

uncontrolled.label: Uncontrolled
uncontrolled.schedule: Charge at parking arrival at sampled charger power until requested energy or parking time is exhausted.

NHTS2022.behavior: Unweighted filtered national sample of household-vehicle drivers; zero-trip people are excluded from the daily-distance denominator.
NHTS2022.reviewed_correction: Weekend daily distance aligned from 57.75 to saved notebook result 56.13 km; raw survey was not independently re-extracted.
NHTS2022.source_access: Public survey; this catalogue contains prepared aggregate parameters, not a new raw-data fetch or full derivation.
NHTS2022.source_edition: Legacy notebook-derived 2022 evidence; exact original public-use release is not independently pinned by the prepared tables.
NHTS2022.timing: Hourly distributions use intentional trip midpoint occurrence; main time windows derive separately from trip start-time plots.

TTS2016.behavior: User-accepted reuse of weekday behavior on weekends because survey observations exclude weekends; inherited weekend activity probabilities remain 0.6 Saturday and 0.5 Sunday.
TTS2016.rounding_note: Prepared 39 km retains plausible integer rounding of the captured 38.65 km weekday mean.
TTS2016.source_access: Restricted/nonpublic underlying travel records; only the already prepared aggregate RAMP tables are included.
TTS2016.survey: 2016 Transportation Tomorrow Survey, Ontario Greater Golden Horseshoe
TTS2016.timing: Prepared aggregate trip occurrence/window parameters copied from the reviewed legacy derivation.

tree_contract.database: Prepared aggregate survey/driver/vehicle/weather input tables under database/{survey}; no private raw TTS records.
tree_contract.model: Archival Python/control snapshot preserving original relative source paths; environment binaries/caches are excluded. Paths in original controls describe the external RAMP workspace; this snapshot is evidence, not a second CANOE simulation scheduler.
tree_contract.results: Six charging CSVs and exact original per-run metadata under results/{survey}/{strategy}.
